sources.title: ClinSeek-35B-A3B: Open Agentic Clinical LLM
sources.snippet: ClinSeek-35B-A3B is an open-source 35B parameter LLM designed for automated, agentic clinical reasoning that leverages EHR data and multiple medical tools. It utilizes supervised fine-tuning on high-quality, tool-augmented reasoning trajectories, improving SQL-based querying for efficient clinical evidence retrieval.
